name: Aider
description: Aider is an open-source AI pair programmer that edits files in a local git repository and commits its own changes. This repository wraps its CLI behind the Agents Hub HTTP contract.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Model key Aider uses for its own completions. Swap for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY if you set AIDER_MODEL to a Claude model.

env.name: AIDER_MODEL
env.description: Model passed to aider --model. Defaults to whatever aider picks for the key it finds.

env.name: AIDER_WORKDIR
env.description: Git repository aider edits when a run does not name a workspace. Defaults to /work.
